propositions: A runaway read_file loop truncates evidence search and aborts; truncated criteria are never banked (entry is None), causing _restamp_marker to pop the insufficiency marker instead of stamping it, minting bare met=false indistinguishable from genuine refutation.

reconcile_verdict sets top-level evidence_sufficient=False for insufficiency-only failures but does not set verdict_obtainable=False, so close_precheck and verify-completion still route through hard-coded exit 1 instead of retryable exit 11.

The fix stamps met=false with entry is None (un-banked/truncated) as evidence_sufficient=False; routes insufficiency-only faults through new shared helper completion_fail_returncode that returns exit 11 for faults, else exit 1.

Genuine refutations (conclusive bank entry with no insufficiency marker) remain unmasked as exit 1 hard blocks; the no-criterion fault (verdict_obtainable=False) preserves existing exit 11 behavior unchanged.

Deterministic regression tests (no LLM) validate insufficiency-only disposition as retryable exit 11, genuine failures as exit 1, and the pre-existing 2a6f no-criterion fault still exit 11 under mutations.
